title: 🚩 Kind of People You Find in Fuoco Islamabad Part 1
body: A couple on a very clearly family-approved first meeting, sitting so close to the candle neither of them can actually see the other's face, which is honestly the whole point. A guy in a blazer he owns for exactly one restaurant in this city, pointing at "culurgiones" on the menu instead of saying it out loud, because that's not a risk he's taking tonight. A table of overseas Pakistanis loudly missing London, ordering the wagyu because thirteen thousand rupees converts to "basically nothing" in their head. A couple whispering because the room is so quiet a normal voice feels like a confession. Someone's dad paying the bill without looking at it, because looking at it would ruin the performance of not looking at it.
